<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;

// A furniture shop's searches over the last 30 days: term => [ searches, results per search ].
$terms = [
    'shipping'              => [ 25, 3 ],
    'return policy'         => [ 20, 1 ],
    'sofa'                  => [ 18, 12 ],
    'gift card'             => [ 15, 2 ],
    'opening hours'         => [ 12, 0 ],
    'couch'                 => [ 11, 0 ],
    'dining table'          => [ 9, 8 ],
    'size guide'            => [ 8, 1 ],
    'discount code'         => [ 7, 0 ],
    'outdoor furniture'     => [ 6, 6 ],
    'track my order'        => [ 5, 0 ],
    'velvet armchair'       => [ 5, 4 ],
    'assembly instructions' => [ 4, 0 ],
    'warranty'              => [ 3, 1 ],
    'rug'                   => [ 2, 5 ],
];
$countries = [ 'US', 'US', 'US', 'GB', 'GB', 'DE', 'CA', 'FR', 'ES', 'AU', 'NL', 'RO' ];

mt_srand( 7 );

foreach ( $terms as $term => [ $searches, $results ] ) {
    $wpdb->insert( $wpdb->prefix . 'mwt_search_terms', [ 'term' => $term, 'total_count' => $searches ] );
    $term_id = $wpdb->insert_id;

    $rows = [];
    for ( $i = 0; $i < $searches; $i++ ) {
        $rows[] = $wpdb->prepare(
            '(%d, %s, %d, %s, 0)',
            $term_id,
            gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - mt_rand( 0, 30 * DAY_IN_SECONDS ) ),
            $results,
            $countries[ mt_rand( 0, count( $countries ) - 1 ) ]
        );
    }
    $wpdb->query( "INSERT INTO {$wpdb->prefix}mwt_search_history (term_id, datetime, count_posts, country, user_id) VALUES " . implode( ',', $rows ) );
}

// Shows the country column with flags.
$settings = get_option( 'mwtsa_settings', [] );
$settings['mwtsa_save_search_country'] = 1;
update_option( 'mwtsa_settings', $settings );
